rows.label: BMW
rows.hook: builds cars and motorcycles under a blue-and-white roundel badge

rows.label: CNN
rows.hook: pioneered around-the-clock television coverage of current events

rows.label: FIFA
rows.description: international governing body of association football
rows.hook: organizes the men's and women's soccer World Cup

rows.label: MTV
rows.hook: began broadcasting with a song about video killing the radio star

rows.label: NBC
rows.hook: is symbolized by a colorful peacock and airs Saturday Night Live

rows.label: Aldi
rows.description: brand name of two global discount supermarket chains
rows.hook: is a grocery chain known for no-frills stores and rock-bottom prices

rows.label: IBM
rows.hook: is nicknamed Big Blue and built the Deep Blue chess computer

rows.label: CBS
rows.description: American broadcast television and radio network
rows.hook: is identified by an eye logo and airs NFL games and late-night talk shows

rows.label: HBO
rows.hook: produced series like The Sopranos and Game of Thrones

rows.label: Sega
rows.description: Japanese video game developer and publisher and subsidiary of Sega Sammy Holdings
rows.hook: created Sonic the Hedgehog and the Dreamcast console

rows.label: KFC
rows.description: American fast food restaurant chain specializing in fried chicken
rows.hook: is built around a white-suited colonel and a secret blend of eleven herbs and spices

rows.label: IKEA
rows.hook: sells flat-pack furniture and serves meatballs in its stores

rows.label: HSBC
rows.hook: is a London-headquartered lender with deep roots in Asia

rows.label: ESPN
rows.hook: is home to SportsCenter, the X Games and Monday Night Football

rows.label: BP
rows.description: British multinational oil and gas company
rows.hook: sells fuel under a green and yellow sunburst logo

rows.label: AMD
rows.hook: makes Ryzen processors and Radeon graphics cards

rows.label: AT&T
rows.hook: once held a phone monopoly that was split into regional Baby Bells

rows.label: Intel
rows.hook: makes processors for PCs and is known for a five-note jingle and Inside stickers

rows.label: NASCAR
rows.stands_for: National Association for Stock Car Auto Racing
rows.hook: runs the Daytona 500 and races on oval tracks

rows.label: AOL
rows.description: American web portal and online service provider
rows.hook: greeted dial-up subscribers with a famous You've Got Mail voice

rows.label: KLM
rows.description: flag carrier airline of the Netherlands
rows.hook: is the oldest airline still flying under its original name

rows.label: H&M
rows.hook: sells fast-fashion clothes and runs designer collaborations

rows.label: Saab Group
rows.hook: builds Gripen fighter jets and once built quirky cars

rows.label: Fiat
rows.hook: makes the tiny 500 city car and is part of Stellantis

rows.label: 3M
rows.hook: invented Post-it Notes and Scotch tape

rows.label: Haribo
rows.hook: invented the gummy bear

rows.label: BASF
rows.description: German chemical company with worldwide reach
rows.hook: is the world's largest chemical producer

rows.label: AMC Theatres
rows.description: US-based movie theater chain in the US and Europe
rows.hook: is the largest movie-house chain in the world

rows.label: Nabisco
rows.hook: makes Oreos and Ritz crackers

rows.label: NEC
rows.hook: made the PC Engine game console and PC-98 computers

rows.label: GEICO
rows.hook: is fronted by a talking gecko and a slogan about saving money in 15 minutes

rows.label: IHOP
rows.description: American multinational pancake house restaurant chain
rows.hook: is a diner chain known for all-day breakfast
